result.instructions: The repository's architecture rules as tools. Ask can_import before writing an import, impact before editing a file, place before creating one; each answer names the rule and its fix.

tools.name: rules
tools.description: Every rule with its family, severity, comment, fix and what it matched on each side (rulebearing rules --json)

unused.description: List the rules that matched nothing in each of the last --releases snapshots (--unused)

releases.description: With unused: how many snapshots to read (--releases)

graph.description: A saved cruise result to answer from instead of the server's warm graph (--graph)

tools.name: explain
tools.description: One rule: its sentence, why it exists, its fix, what it matches and the first edges it flagged (rulebearing explain <rule> --json)

rule.description: The rule's name, or allowed[n] for an allowed entry

plain.description: The sentence alone, no graph read (--plain)

graph.description: A saved cruise result to answer from instead of the server's warm graph (--graph)

tools.name: can_import
tools.description: Would an import from one file to another be allowed, and if not which rule says so and what to do (rulebearing can-import <from> <to> --json)

graph.description: A saved cruise result to answer from instead of the server's warm graph (--graph)

tools.name: place
tools.description: The folders where a new module with these imports and importers would be legal (rulebearing place --json)

language.description: The new module's language: ts, js, python or dotnet (--language)

imports.description: Files the new module would import (--imports)

importedBy.description: Files that would import the new module (--imported-by)

graph.description: A saved cruise result to answer from instead of the server's warm graph (--graph)

tools.name: impact
tools.description: What a file is subject to before an edit: the rules that reach it, its dependents and the violations it is in (rulebearing impact <file> --json)

file.description: The file about to be edited

depth.description: How many levels of dependents to list (--depth)

graph.description: A saved cruise result to answer from instead of the server's warm graph (--graph)

tools.name: count
tools.description: How many direct edges go from modules matching one pattern to targets matching another, against a ratchet's budget when given (rulebearing count --json)

to.description: Targets, a regular expression; $1 takes the capture from from (--to)

budget.description: A budget file, { "ceiling": n }, to compare with (--budget)

graph.description: A saved cruise result to answer from instead of the server's warm graph (--graph)

tools.name: query
tools.description: The direct edges from modules matching one pattern to targets matching another (rulebearing query --json)

to.description: Targets, a regular expression; $1 takes the capture from from (--to)

graph.description: A saved cruise result to answer from instead of the server's warm graph (--graph)

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Added and removed edges, new and resolved violations and moved ratchets between two saved results, or between a revision and the working tree (rulebearing diff -T json)

base.description: A revision to compare the working tree with, instead of two results (--base)

paths.description: With base: what to cruise on each side
